name: ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES
description: The Auth Entities table contains information about the providers and locations associated with an authorization request. A row in this table represents a single entity, with the data columns representing specific pieces of information about the entity.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the auth bundle record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID_REF
columns.description: The unique identifier for the entity related line. Unique among all related group lines on the Auth Bundle.

columns.name: AUTH_ENTITY_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Auth Entity Type category ID for this auth entity.

columns.name: ENTITY_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: ENTITY_LOC_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: ENTITY_DEPT_ID_EXTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: The external name of the department record. This is often used in patient correspondence such as reminder letters.

columns.name: ENTITY_VENDOR_ID_VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: The name of the vendor.

columns.name: ENTITY_HOUSE_NUM
columns.description: The house number associated with the entity's address information.

columns.name: ENTITY_CITY
columns.description: The city associated with the entity's address information.

columns.name: ENTITY_STATE_C_NAME
columns.description: The State category ID for this auth entity's address information.

columns.name: ENTITY_ZIP
columns.description: The ZIP code associated with the entity's address information.

columns.name: ENTITY_DISTRICT_C_NAME
columns.description: The District category ID for this auth entity's address information.

columns.name: ENTITY_COUNTY_2_C_NAME
columns.description: The County category ID for this auth entity's address information.

columns.name: ENTITY_COUNTRY_2_C_NAME
columns.description: The Country category ID for this auth entity's address information.

columns.name: ENTITY_ORG_NAME
columns.description: The entity's organization name, only used for entities that are locations (as opposed to providers).

columns.name: ENTITY_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: The entity's first name, usually relevant to provider type entities.

columns.name: ENTITY_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.description: The entity's middle name, usually relevant to provider type entities.

columns.name: ENTITY_LAST_NAME
columns.description: The entity's last name, usually relevant to provider type entities.

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME_SUFFIX_C_NAME
columns.description: The Suffix category ID for this auth entity's name information.

columns.name: ENTITY_AUTH_ROLE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Auth Entity Role category ID for this auth entity's auth role.

columns.name: ENTITY_PRIMARY_TAXONOMY
columns.description: The primary taxonomy code used for this entity.
